text: The idea that the root apex acts like the brain of a lowly animal, the 'root-brain' hypothesis later revived by Baluska's group, originates with Charles ___, who studied root-tip movements together with his son Francis.
explanation: The answer is Darwin. Charles Darwin (with Francis Darwin, in The Power of Movement in Plants, 1880) proposed the root-brain analogy; Baluska and colleagues later extended it to the root-apex transition zone as a 'command centre,' a claim most plant biologists regard as overstated.
